# SellStatic

> SellStatic is an AI-powered marketing platform that turns one-line briefs into on-brand ads, videos, and social posts, and publishes them across multiple platforms from a single workspace.

SellStatic helps marketing teams generate ad variations in seconds, schedule posts across major social networks, and track performance from one dashboard. Built for speed, brand consistency, and measurable growth.

## Core Features

- AI Ad Generator, describe your offer and get 100+ on-brand ad variations in seconds
- AI Video Director, turn a link, image, or text into a multi-scene video ad
- Brand Kit Sync, logo, fonts, and colors applied automatically to every asset
- Multi-Platform Publishing, schedule and post to multiple networks from one calendar
- Performance Analytics, real-time CTR, impressions, and conversion tracking
- Live Collaboration, shareable previews and comments before publish
- 300+ Templates, professionally designed for every industry and format

## Connected Platforms

Facebook, Instagram, Threads, X (Twitter), TikTok, LinkedIn, Pinterest, YouTube, Twitch, Google Business, and Meta Ads, Google Ads, and TikTok Ads.
